## Detailed Breakdown of Flagship Production Projects

### 1. Enterprise AI Agent Control Plane (https://github.com/NadeemAhmad3/ai-agent-control-plane)
- **Architecture**: Distributed autonomous agent control plane with deterministic state-machine recovery, Redis event sourcing, and automated circuit breakers.
- **Features**: Microsecond step tracing, token rate limiting, and dead-letter queues to eliminate infinite agent execution loops in production.
- **Technologies**: Python, FastAPI, Redis, OpenTelemetry, AsyncIO, PyTest.

### 2. vLLM High-Performance LLM Inference & Serving Engine (https://github.com/NadeemAhmad3/vllm)
- **Architecture**: High-throughput LLM serving engine powered by PagedAttention virtual memory management and custom CUDA kernels.
- **Features**: Eliminates 96% of KV-cache memory waste, Continuous Iteration Batching, and OpenAI-compatible HTTP server.
- **Technologies**: Python, C++, CUDA, PyTorch, OpenAI API Server.

### 3. Universal AI Gateway & LLM Proxy Server (https://github.com/NadeemAhmad3/unified-llm-proxy-server)
- **Architecture**: Universal OpenAI-compatible gateway proxying 100+ LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock, Gemini, Vertex AI, Ollama).
- **Features**: Sub-8ms P95 latency, virtual tenant API keys, monthly dollar budget caps, automated cross-provider fallbacks, real-time token spend accounting.
- **Technologies**: Python, Rust Core, LiteLLM, Docker, Prometheus, FastAPI.

### 4. Enterprise RAG Data Framework & Document Agent Platform (https://github.com/NadeemAhmad3/enterprise-rag-data-framework)
- **Architecture**: Enterprise data orchestration framework for hybrid dense/sparse RAG indexing and autonomous document agents.
- **Features**: 300+ data loaders, hybrid BM25 + dense vector similarity search, Cross-Encoder reranking, and PropertyGraphIndex knowledge graphs.
- **Technologies**: Python, LlamaIndex, Vector DBs (Qdrant, Pinecone, Milvus), Cohere Rerank.

### 5. Self-Improving AI Pipelines & Prompt Optimization Engine (https://github.com/NadeemAhmad3/self-improving-ai-pipelines)
- **Architecture**: Declarative LM programming framework replacing manual prompt engineering with automated prompt compilers.
- **Features**: MIPROv2 Bayesian prompt optimization, BootstrapFewShot example curation, and runtime computational assertions (`dspy.Assert`).
- **Technologies**: Python, DSPy, MIPROv2, BootstrapFewShot, LiteLLM.

### 6. Distributed AI Compute Engine (https://github.com/NadeemAhmad3/distributed-ai-compute-engine)
- **Architecture**: Unified distributed computing platform for scaling ML training, Ray Serve, and multi-GPU clusters.
- **Features**: Stateless Tasks, stateful remote Actors holding GPU weights in VRAM, and zero-copy shared memory object store (Plasma).
- **Technologies**: Ray Core, Ray Serve, Ray Train, Plasma Shared Memory, C++.

### 7. 100-Day AI Engineering Production Laboratory (https://github.com/NadeemAhmad3/AI-Engineering-Lab)
- **Overview**: Daily hands-on engineering lab implementing production AI patterns:
  - Day 01–05: ML Inference Latency Optimization, ThreadPool Concurrency, Batch Inference, and Async Processing Queues.
  - Day 06–10: CPU vs. GPU Benchmarking, AWQ/GPTQ Model Quantization, Redis Semantic AI Caching, and Production Serving.
  - Day 11–14: Hybrid RAG Retrieval, Cross-Encoder Reranking, Dynamic Chunking, and Context Latency Optimization.
  - Day 15–18: RAG Hallucination Mitigation, Structured Outputs with Pydantic, and Automated LLM-as-a-Judge Evaluators.
  - Day 19–20: Agent Reliability, Circuit Breakers, and Distributed Fault Tolerance.
